case.summary: This investigation was triggered by a customer report denying the disputed $131.30 online transaction, identifying card-not-present fraud matching similar historical cases. Evidence used includes the customer's high-volume transaction history, graph analysis revealing the device is shared across four customers and linked to cards with confirmed fraud, and case memory retrievals. Per policy R2, because the customer denied the transaction and the case connects to a shared device profile, we recommend blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a report. Additionally, rule R6 triggers monitoring of connected cards due to the shared device origin among multiple customers.

sar.narrative: Customer C11923 reported that they never authorized the $131.30 online transaction 3583368. Investigation revealed that the transaction was conducted on a device profile (D-f5e3dab905c2) shared among four different customers, two of whom are linked to confirmed-fraud history on other cards. Because the customer denied the charge and the activity connects to a compromised shared device profile, Rule R2 requires blocking the card, creating a case, and filing a report. Similar prior cases in case memory also substantiate confirmed fraud patterns under these conditions.
